assistant|diy_project_idea: Wine Cork Bulletin Board: collect wine corks, arrange in square/rectangle, glue together, add fabric backing
Newspaper Flower Vase: roll newspaper strips, weave into vase, seal with Mod Podge for water resistance
Bottle Cap Coasters: arrange bottle caps in a pattern on a cork base, glue and seal
Mason Jar Wall Planter: attach metal hose clamps to a wooden board, insert Mason jars with soil and small plants
Scrap Fabric Rag Rug: braid old T-shirts or fabric scraps into strands, coil and sew into a rug
assistant|sustainable_decor_tip: Use LED light bulbs to save energy and last longer
Choose sustainable fabrics like organic cotton, bamboo, or hemp
Add indoor plants to bring in natural elements, purify air, and improve mood
Find furniture made from FSC-certified wood to ensure sustainable harvesting
Use natural cleaning products instead of harsh chemicals for environment and health
assistant|eco_furniture_retailer: Online retailers specializing in eco-friendly furniture: Greenington, Vivaterra, and Joybird
assistant|eco_furniture_source: Secondhand stores: thrift stores, consignment shops, and antique stores for vintage pieces
Custom furniture makers who use sustainable materials and practices
Local artisans creating furniture from reclaimed or salvaged materials
DIY projects: upcycle old pieces or use bamboo, reclaimed wood, or recycled metal
